result.meaning: After replacing observation-period dates with verified official release dates for the first engine-eligible Growth/Labour data around the common gate, the latest currency gate is Japan. The May 2020 Labour Force Survey required to make the JPY Labour block engine-eligible was publicly reported by the Statistics Bureau on 2020-07-31.
result.important_warning: This is still not FULL_PIT_READY. It resolves publication timing around the start gate, but first-release versus revised values across the historical panel remain to be audited.

USD.series_family: BEA Personal Income and Outlays, May 2020
USD.evidence: BEA release was embargoed until 08:30 EDT on 2020-06-26 and contains May real PCE / income information.

EUR.evidence: Eurostat release 108/2020 dated 2020-07-06 published May 2020 retail-trade volume.

GBP.evidence: ONS released May 2020 retail sales at 07:00 on 2020-06-19.

JPY.series_family: Statistics Bureau Labour Force Survey, May 2020
JPY.evidence: Statistics Bureau News Bulletin dated 2020-07-31 reports May 2020 employed persons, unemployed persons and unemployment rate.
JPY.note: Japan becomes the binding G8 release-date gate in this first clean-start reconstruction.

CHF.evidence: FSO press release embargoed 2020-06-30 08:30 reports provisional May 2020 real and nominal retail turnover.

CAD.series_family: Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey, June 2020
CAD.evidence: Statistics Canada release schedule maps the June 14-20 2020 reference period to 2020-07-10; The Daily release confirms 2020-07-10.

AUD.series_family: ABS Australian National Accounts, March quarter 2020
AUD.evidence: ABS released March-quarter 2020 National Accounts at 11:30 AEST on 2020-06-03.

NZD.series_family: Stats NZ Labour market statistics, March 2018 quarter
NZD.evidence: The March 2018 quarter labour-market release was published 2020-clean-sample-well-before-gate, on 2018-05-02.
NZD.note: NZD was not the common-sample bottleneck.

comparison_with_previous_gate.explanation: The stored observation date is not the information date. Release timing pushes the clean common G8 start later; Japan's delayed May 2020 Labour Force Survey is the binding case.

next_gate: Audit first-release/revision behavior for each active Macro Core series over 2020-2026.
Where official vintage data exist, reconstruct the value actually known at each checkpoint.
Where only revised history is recoverable, label the series REVISED_ONLY and quantify sensitivity with/without it.
After vintage audit, declare the final Macro PIT start date and build monthly checkpoint panel.
